2034-2169-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-2169-4694-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

225-1809-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-1809-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Returned Pastcaller and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Returned Pastcaller and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-1809-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Returned Pastcaller and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

225-2438-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
225-2438-2577-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1651-4231-4732-5261--108.notablePrerequisites: You control another artifact or creature.
1651-4231-4732-5261--108.description:
Use the creature copy effect to make an additional copy of Academy Manufactor.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it to cast a copy of Deadly Dispute without paying its mana cost.
As an additional cost to cast Deadly Dispute, sacrifice a creature or artifact.
Resolve Deadly Dispute, drawing two cards and creating three Food tokens, three Clue tokens, and three Treasure tokens due to the two Academy Manufactors.
Activate two of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add two mana.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two untapped artifacts you control to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist

4050-7936--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4050-7936--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur, adding one mana.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
Repeat.

586-864-2511-3125-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2511-3125-5477.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a basic Forest you control

104-475-3197-3263.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-475-3197-3263.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-3967-4871-4976.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-1409-4460-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

5291-6250-6757.description:
Cast Daretti by paying {4}{R} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Daretti enters the battlefield, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions token.
Resolve the Daretti trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Munitions to return Cursed Mirror from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Daretti.
Put Cursed Mirror into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cursed Mirror, the Munitions token that was sacrificed and Weapons Manufacturing each trigger.
Resolve the Munitions trigger, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions token..
Resolve the Cursed Mirror trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Munitions to return Cursed Mirror from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Daretti.
Repeat from step 5.

511-817-4050-6441-7704.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

3212-4452-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Kefnet.
When God-Eternal Kefnet dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Kefnet's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Kefnet.
As God-Eternal Kefnet is a Lhurgoyf due to Rukarumel, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Kefnet from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-5189-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Ghave.
When Ghave dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1491-3755-6218-7267.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

4659-5320-6291.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
4659-5320-6291.description:
Use Krark-Clan Ironworks to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Stridehangar Automaton.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and the Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
4659-5320-6291.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Krark-Clan Ironworks, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

4050-4446-4681-5170.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
4050-4446-4681-5170.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

147-780-2438.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

618-5686-6966.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3771-6869-6884.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
3771-6869-6884.description:
Cast Aang, Airbending Master by paying {2}{W}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Aang, Airbending Master enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, the Last Airbender
Cast Aang, the Last Airbender from exile by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Aang, the Last Airbender enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, Airbending Master.
Cast Aang, Airbending Master from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.
3771-6869-6884.notes: You can perform this combo if Animar has fewer +1/+1 counters on it. If Animar has exactly one counter, add {1} to the mana cost. If Animar has no counters, add {3} to the mana cost. If Animar has more than two counters, you can reduce the cost to {1}{W} or {W}.

1850-4935-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4935-5412.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1387-1500-2100-6596.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Blood Funnel and Hermes trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Hermes trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

2034-3000-4593-6097.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-3000-4593-6097.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1020-1117-3497-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3129-4636-5770-6753.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

2034-2653-5552-6664.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten permanents.
2034-2653-5552-6664.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation and untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5256-5567-6254--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5256-5567-6254--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

325-2275-3017-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-2275-3017-6282.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat.

1339-2122-4029-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-4029-4050.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

2187-2593-4067-6281.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Possessed Skaab.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Possessed Skaab that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Possessed Skaab from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

2167-5626-5721-6517.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-5626-5721-6517.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2084-5362.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2084-5362.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

4050-5276-6412.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder, adding one mana of any color.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Pre-War Formalwear from exile to the battlefield.
When Pre-War Formalwear enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Pre-War Formalwear to it.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-1251-2511.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1251-2511.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1336-4824-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1336-4824-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Heronblade Elite's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

81-1495-4120.easyPrerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
81-1495-4120.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
81-1495-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

2605-4235-4644.notablePrerequisites: Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
2605-4235-4644.description:
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Lotus Vale.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping Tidewater Minion and Lotus Vale.
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {3}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any permanent instead of Lotus Vale.

1660-2426-3603-5236.description:
Cast Natural Affinity by paying {2}{G} causing all lands into 2/2 creatures until end of turn.
Cast Act of Treason by paying {2}{R}, targeting Ink-Treader Nephilim.
Ink-Treader Nephilim triggers, copying Act of Treason for each creatures, gaining control of creatures until end of turn.
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Ink-Treader Nephilim.
Ink-Treader Nephilim triggers, copying Cloudshift for each creature.
The Cloudshift copies resolve, exiling all creatures you control and returning them to the battlefield under your control.
